headline: Pasadena Craftsman Bungalow Roof Replacement
articleBody:
Historic 1923 home with failing asphalt shingles and poor ventilation causing attic mold. Replaced with architectural shingles, added ridge/soffit vents, repaired decking.

Outcome: Eliminated leaks, improved energy efficiency by 25%, preserved architectural style while meeting HOA approval. Homeowner reported cooler attic temps.
